scope: Native Chromium WebGL2 desktop/phone river entry, followed by labelled isolated above/low-gunwale views of the three real fishing hulls and original working skiff. Exact former geometry and current geometry share production materials, river-water mesh, camera and depth state. Interior pixel patches compare each mesh with and without water; the current interior must hide water and the former overhead view must reproduce leakage. Low views include maximum prescribed bob/pitch/roll for fishing hulls. Gameplay is frozen; no mission outcome, physical Safari or hardware-FPS claim.
